matthew.28.p1.b1.text: After the Sabbath, at dawn on the first day of the week,

matthew.28.p1.b2.text: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to see the tomb.

matthew.28.p1.b3.text: Suddenly there was a great earthquake,

matthew.28.p1.b4.text: for an angel of the Lord descended from heaven, rolled away the stone, and sat on it.

matthew.28.p2.b1.text: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothes were white as snow.

matthew.28.p2.b2.text: The guards trembled in fear of him

matthew.28.p3.b1.text: Do not be afraid, for I know that you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified.

matthew.28.p3.b2.text: He is not here; He has risen, just as He said! Come, see the place where He lay.

matthew.28.p3.b3.text: Then go quickly and tell His disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead and is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see Him.’

matthew.28.p4.b1.text: So they hurried away from the tomb in fear and great joy, and ran to tell His disciples.

matthew.28.p4.b2.text: Suddenly Jesus met them and said,

matthew.28.p4.b4.text: They came to Him, grasped His feet, and worshiped Him.

matthew.28.p5.b1.text: Do not be afraid … Go and tell My brothers

matthew.28.p5.b2.text: to go to Galilee. There they will see Me.

matthew.28.p5.b3.text: While the women were on their way, some of the guards went into the city

matthew.28.p5.b4.text: and reported to the chief priests all that had happened.

matthew.28.p6.b1.text: And after the chief priests had met with the elders and formed a plan, they gave the soldiers a large sum of money

matthew.28.p6.b2.text: and instructed them: “You are to say, ‘His disciples came by night and stole Him away while we were asleep.’

matthew.28.p6.b3.text: If this report reaches the governor, we will satisfy him and keep you out of trouble.”

matthew.28.p6.b4.text: And this account has been circulated among the Jews to this very day.

matthew.28.p7.b1.text: Meanwhile, the eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain Jesus had designated.

matthew.28.p7.b2.text: When they saw Him, they worshiped Him,

matthew.28.p8.b1.text: Then Jesus came to them and said,

matthew.28.p8.b2.text: All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to Me.

matthew.28.p8.b3.text: Therefore go and make disciples of all nations,

matthew.28.p8.b4.text: baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit,

matthew.28.p9.b1.text: and teaching them to obey all that I have commanded you.

matthew.28.p9.b2.text: And surely I am with you always,

matthew.28.p9.b3.text: even to the end of the age.
